summary: Andretti Acquisition Corp. II, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing non-redemption agreements with unaffiliated investors. Under these agreements, the sponsor and company will issue up to 250,000 Pubco shares (or 83,333 if business combination occurs after June 9, 2027) for investors' agreement not to redeem up to 1,000,000 public shares. This is a SPAC-related arrangement to retain trust funds ahead of an extension vote, not a standalone special situation; it is a routine tactic in SPAC extension processes. No deal terms disclosed; watch for shareholder vote outcome and business combination progress.
